semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.join_rule: Exact 1-based candidate index suffix (_cXX -> genomes[XX - 1]) AND matching family tag AND matching certificate_identity SHA-256.
semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.negative_fixture_zero_based: Interpreting _cXX as 0-based genomes[XX] misjoins 2,247 of 2,259 retained screen rows and must fail closed.
semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.missing_screen_semantics: The 1,390 birth-minus-screen rows are missing screen observations (never assert an unsupported 809 failed-FEM count or treat absent screen rows as demonstrated FEM solver failures).
semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.missing_weighted_fitness_semantics: All 2,259 screen rows record Stage-1 screen metrics (mass_g, fat_sf, seq_ratio, ring_bearing_w_mm, screen_deficit) and lack ultralight_weighted_fitness; never backfill missing score fields without explicit derived provenance.
semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.fail_closed_publication_rs_guard_preserv: crates/paper-artifacts/src/publication.rs:907-934 fail-closed refusal when uninvited round files appear beside an admitted summary is preserved untouched.
semantic_and_erratum_safeguards.no_unique_design_summation: Do not sum 3,649 birth events with the 1,984 historical w282 births as a unique-design total (3,649 birth events span 1,284 distinct certificate_identity hashes).
